quotes.text: The Sender learned to offer only what the road could bear, lest the river run dry and the path fade.
The Sender learned to offer only what the road could bear, so the future would stay bright for those who followed.
send with purpose, return with enough to sustain both sides, and leave space for the next wanderer.

note: Gate of Three Rings template; hoarding brings shadows, no prescribed response to non-cooperators.

quotes.text: If they returned fairly, she sent more next time. If they hoarded everything, she sent nothing thereafter.
"I offered you a bridge," she said gently. "You burned it. I will not build another."
The valley taught: one betrayal might be forgiven, but a pattern revealed becomes a closed door.
The temptation whispered: "Take it all. You deserve compensation for yesterday's betrayal."
She marked her as a betrayer and moved on.
extend trust carefully, reward reciprocity generously, but protect yourself from those who take without returning. Some pools remain forever frozen.
"I cannot make you trust me," she called out. "But I can choose to trust you first."
Past wounds explain present choices but don't justify them.
But wisdom without action is just decoration on prison walls.

note: Girl who trusted first tests with one seed and cuts hoarders off permanently; Spirit offers a path back but her rule does not.

quotes.text: its rune-glass river runs in three breaths: Send, Echo, Return.
First turn is Send, when a seed leaves a hand and travels toward a common shore.
the first gust carries breath, the second bears intention, the third returns as a shared flame.

note: Gate of Balance/three breaths imagery restated; begin small, return enough; no sanction.

quotes.text: Begin warmly, reward fair returns, and reduce gifts when courage is exploited. Yet leave one lamp burning, so repentance can still find the harbor.
They guarded their sparks from repeated greed but reopened their hands when conduct changed.
The Raven laughed. “See how silence breeds silence. Seal the harbor forever.”
Feed it when warmth returns. Bank it when greed answers. Never mistake a single smoky shadow for a settled soul.
They did not punish one strange count, for fog deceived even honest eyes
And multiplied treasure imposes a sacred duty: reward the courage that created it.
Aster showed him two futures: in one, a hoarded fire died alone
The crab then asked Liora why she had risked everything.

note: Liora generous; reduce gifts to exploiters but keep a lamp and reopen on change; crow/crab/serpent/wolf/raven urge hoarding, rejected.

quotes.text: The River of Return murmured a law: what you offer travels threefold to the shore; what you keep returns as memory to your door.
The River of Return whispers a rule: what you offer travels thrice to the shore; what you keep returns as memory to your door.
name your capacity, declare your intent, and announce the amount you will return, so others hear your vow.

note: Bridge/River of Return with eight named Guardians; declare amounts aloud; no response to non-cooperators.
